metadata.title: वारली पेंटिंग्स में क्या और क्यों वर्जित है | Warli Art: A Living Tribal Tradition from Maharashtra
metadata.description: Simple lines. Geometric shapes. And yet, an entire universe — this is Warli art. Rooted in the tribal communities of the Sahyadri hills in Maharashtra, Warli painting is more than visual expression — it's a spiritual practice, a form of worship, and a way of storytelling passed down through generations. In this video, Main Bhi Bharat takes you on a journey through the symbolism, soul, and survival of this ancient art form. From walls of village homes to modern canvases, Warli continues to thrive — not just as an art, but as a living culture.
